integrity: Proof and a standalone deterministic rational checker are included. Universal claims rely on proof; external validation has not occurred. The reported numerical root is approximate.
scientific_limitations: Exact single-probe risk classification only for real spherical sampling on two-level SPD matrices with a one-dimensional small-eigenvalue subspace; endpoint interpolator assumes exact eigenvalue ratio. Both estimators are benchmarks, not algorithms for recovering an already completely known rank-one spectral model.
title: A dimension-sharp mean-square risk reversal for one-node inverse spectral quadrature
